This hands-on workshop introduces the techniques needed to securely set faceted gemstones into sterling silver tube settings, creating a modern setting style that highlights the brilliance and beauty of each stone. Tube settings are a versatile stone-setting method used by professional jewelers to create sleek designs with minimal metal surrounding the gemstone.
